decisions.decision: Keep the STT->Claude->TTS cascade; do not adopt speech-to-speech
decisions.rationale: Every S2S option needs an open-weight LLM backbone to attach an audio adapter to, and Claude is API-only, so S2S means replacing Claude. validation.py also scans Claude's response TEXT for V-speeds/altitudes/frequencies - an audio-out model produces nothing to validate. Treat adopting S2S as requiring an ADR.

decisions.decision: Gate STT backend swaps on aviation-term WER, not published WER
decisions.rationale: Published WER is dominated by conversational filler and cannot distinguish a backend that drops 'uh' from one that hears 'one zero thousand' as 'one thousand'

decisions.decision: Synthetic eval audio is for CI regression and SNR curves only, never thresholds
decisions.rationale: Clean TTS makes every backend score near-perfect so the gate stops discriminating; synthetic speech is also common ASR training augmentation, which can flatter cloud backends over local ones
Two of its four original deliverables (phase-aware gating, envelope rules) already shipped with Phase 1 as command_safety.py
